10012141.note: The pin is at the edge of the group site's gravel lot by the river, and the drawn loop round the lot and the drive in from the road pass beside it.

252281.note: The pin is on the group site's gravel loop on the bench above the creek, with a shelter at its edge, and the drawn road loops through it.

257007.note: The pin is beside the group site's shade shelter at the edge of its gravel pad, where the drawn road passes 15 m west.

10007160.note: The pin is on the cabin in the meadow. The drawn Census road ended 80 m east, so the dirt lane from its end round to the cabin's clearing, plain in the meadow, is traced.

10010172.note: The pin is on the group camp's paved lot on the bench above the river, inside the drawn loop off the highway.

10040020.note: The pin is in the group camp's gravel clearing among its buildings, and the drawn road ends 20 m northwest of it.

10040565.note: The pin is on the drawn road at the edge of the guard station's clearing, 40 m north of its buildings, which the drawn road reaches.

10163081.note: The pin is on the cabin at the end of its gravel turnaround in the meadow. Replaced the source line that ran up to 20 m west of the track: the gravel track up the slope from Road 058 and the turnaround loop by the cabin are now traced from the photo, within about 3 m of the gravel.

10165195.note: Full canopy: the pin is in forest between the highway and the river, 25 m below the drawn road, and no group site clearing shows.

10165611.note: The campground's drawn loop by the river, with cars parked in a clearing under the trees at its far end, shows 140 m south of the pin, which was on the highway's edge; the pin now sits at that clearing on the loop.

10293120.note: The pin is on the residence's roof among the station's buildings, and the drawn road passes 20 m east.

231888.note: The pin is beside a small building in the open meadow, 20 m below the drawn road, which follows the visible gravel road; the group area's open meadow surrounds it.

231889.note: The pin is on the group area's green-roofed shelter in the trees, and the drawn road ends in the loop beside it. The listing's own point, 1.2 km south, is in a neighborhood of houses.

231902.note: The pin is on the group site's shelter at the edge of its gravel turnaround above the reservoir, and the drawn road loops round the turnaround.

231937.note: Under shadowed canopy, the ground relief shows only lumpy forest floor at the pin and at the Forest Service's point 46 m east, with no levelled stage or seating that marks the theater. Not moved.

231977.note: The pin is in open sagebrush 50 m east of the group site's paved lot, which has a restroom-sized building at its edge; the drawn road passes the lot's west side. The pin is near the site but not on its pad.

231984.note: The Forest Service's point, 267 m east, sits on the camp's entrance lane just off the highway (the relief shows the lane about 5 m east of the drawn one), not on a group clearing, and the pin still shows no site. Not moved.

232116.note: The pin is beside the small loop off the highway where the group site's gravel turnaround shows, and the drawn loop goes round it. The listing's own point, 700 m east, is on the highway at a gravel pull-off.

232205.note: The pin is at the edge of the group site's cleared loop, beside its shelters, and the drawn loop passes 10 m west.

232206.note: The pin is in the group site's clearing at the meadow's edge, beside a small structure, and the drawn loop off the road passes 15 m east.

232209.note: The Forest Service's point 67 m southeast is at a small dirt opening east of the drawn loop and the pin is in open pines north of it; neither shows pads, tables or a structure that mark the group site. Not moved.

232239.note: The pin is on the open slope above the lakeshore, 25 m east of where the drawn road ends at a small building; the group camp's pads don't show plainly.

232291.note: The pin is on the cabin in the meadow, and the drawn Census spur ends 15 m north of it, beside an outbuilding.

232314.note: The Forest Service's point, 2 km east, is under closed conifers south of the river with no clearing, building or lane, and the pin still shows nothing of the organization camp. Not moved.

232374.note: The Forest Service's point, 957 m east-southeast, is under closed canopy beside a shadowed band that may be a lane, with no clearing or pad in the photo and a featureless lidar relief, and the pin still shows no camp. Not moved.

232378.note: The pin is in the group site's open clearing among the parked trailers and tents, and the drawn road through the site passes 20 m east.

232383.note: The pin is in a gravel loop area by the river that looks like a boat launch and parking, while the listing's own point, 9 km west, is a small camp with its own pads beside the highway; the photo can't say which is the group site.

232422.note: The pin is beside the buildings at the trailhead above the lake, and the drawn lanes round the group camp's parking area pass beside it.

232754.note: The pin is on the reservoir's bare bank 15 m east of the drawn loop at the end of the spur, and nothing at it is plainly the group site; the drawn loop is in the trees beside it.

232783.note: Moved the pin 130 m southeast, from unbroken forest onto the bare gravel pad on the east side of the drawn turnaround loop at the end of the spur from the highway, where the Forest Service puts Cove Group; it is the only developed spot near the listing.

232822.note: The Forest Service's point, 220 m east of the pin, is on the wet meadow itself, where no group camp can be; the pin, in pines and open ground between the drawn roads, shows no pad or structure either. Not moved.

233101.note: The pin is in the group site's open grassy flat by the creek, and the drawn loop off the road goes round the flat. The listing's own point, 480 m south, is on the road beside another camp.

233114.note: The Forest Service's point, 100 m east of the pin on the drawn road along the river, shows only a small pale fleck and a patch of bare ground 30 m west of it among trees, nothing plainly a group pad; the ground relief shows no levelled loop at either spot. Not moved.

233128.note: No road is drawn, but the pin is on a small structure at the top of the open rocky butte, with a drawn trail 15 m off.

233132.note: Under the firs the lidar relief shows a building's square footprint, about 12 m across, at the pin (the listing's own point is 4 m away), with the loop drive around its west and south sides plain in the intensity. OpenStreetMap had the loop's southeast side bowing 10 to 15 m off its band; it is retraced on the band from the cabin to the work center spur, and the other roads are OpenStreetMap's, unchanged and on their bands.

233143.note: The Forest Service's point ("Cottonwood Guard Station"), 140 m southeast of the pin on the bench beside the drawn spur, shows a level bench in the relief but no roof; a bright white oblong about 5 by 8 m sits 28 m southeast of the point, too far and too plain-white (a trailer or tarp as easily as a roof) to call the cabin. The pin on the upper road shows nothing. Not moved.

233222.note: The Forest Service's point, 363 m east, is on a levelled terrace under oaks with a small shelter at its west end, but it sits against a cluster of buildings that may be a separate camp or homes, so it can't be told as this group area; the pin is still between wash channels with no pad. Not moved.

233223.note: The pin is at the end of the drawn spur off the highway, in the paved lot by the buildings, which may be the group area. The drawn spur runs up to 10 m off the paved drive.

233305.note: Zoomed in, the photo shows a small cabin roof under the trees at the pin, about 15 m east of the drawn road, but it sits among the resort's cabins and nothing marks it as the guard station; the lidar relief (Oregon DOGAMI) is too smooth here to show a building. The drawn roads follow the resort's lanes. Left as it was.

233682.note: The lidar layers show the area's real lanes east of the pin: a loop at 40 to 90 m east and a road along x 85 to 90 m that the intensity shows as plain bands, while the drawn Census roads cut diagonally across the forest past the pin where the relief shows only a ditch or embankment, not a lane. The pin itself is under the trees with no clearing or pad, so the site can't be placed and the drawn roads don't follow the lanes. Nothing traced.

233775.note: The Forest Service's point, 1.1 km west-northwest and named for the whole Pines campground, is in pine forest on a faint track with no pad or loop, and the pin is still in unbroken scrub; neither shows the group site. Not moved.

233933.note: The Forest Service's point is for the Quaking Aspen group campground, not the cabin, and sits in the open meadow 180 m southwest of the pin with no building; the pin is among the old camp's scattered buildings, and which is the cabin isn't plain. Not moved.

233937.note: The lidar intensity shows the campground lane under the trees as a plain band from the forest road to a small teardrop loop that ends 14 m east of the pin, so the lane and loop are redrawn on it (the Forest Service line ran 5 m north and its southern loop shows no band, so that is dropped) and the forest road east of the camp is re-centered on its band. No pads show inside the canopy, but the loop is the only lane near the pin.

233938.note: The lidar intensity shows the highway north of the pin as a plain paved band with the drawn road on it, but around the pin and along the drawn spur both layers show only an even, lightly mottled forest floor, with no lane, pad or clearing that marks the group site, and the photo shows only canopy. Nothing traced.

233940.note: Under the dense firs the lidar intensity shows the campground's paved lanes as plain bands with the drawn roads on them, and the drawn spur south of the pin ends on a paved lot about 50 m by 12 m, 20 m from the pin, which reads as the group site's parking; the ground at the pin itself shows no pad. Nothing traced.

233942.note: The pin is among the guard station's green-roofed buildings in a clearing, but the drawn road passes 60 m west, and the track from it up to the buildings, faint in the grass, isn't drawn. The listing's own point, 650 m south, is in unbroken forest.

233958.note: The pin is beside the cabin's buildings at the forest edge, where the drawn Forest Service road ends. The listing's own point, 1.1 km north, is on a bare slope with nothing on it.

233972.note: The pin is in the station's meadow 15 m south of its buildings; the drawn spur reaches the north building, but the lane looping in to the two buildings beside the pin shows and isn't drawn.

233985.note: The Forest Service's point 100 m south-southeast falls on the traced loop lane among small ordinary pads, and the pin is under conifers inside the loop; neither shows a group site's clearing. Not moved; the earlier road trace stays.

233986.note: The Forest Service's point, 583 m west, lands on the highway at a spur junction, where the ground relief shows no group pad, and the pin by the river loop still shows none. Not moved.

233987.note: The pin is beside the group site's small gravel clearing below the highway, with a shelter at it, and the drawn spur off the highway loops into the clearing.

234077.note: The Forest Service's point 50 m north shows only scrub and a faint lane, while the pin sits on a bright white square about 4 by 3 m that may be a small roof but is too small to be plainly the cabin. Not moved; the white square needs a second look.

234154.note: The pin is on the open rocky summit, where no structure shows plainly; the small building 50 m northeast at the end of the drawn spur may be the lookout, but the pin isn't on it.

234183.note: The pin is on the small cabin in the aspens, and its short drive (about 30 m, visible) runs to the drawn road but isn't drawn.

234184.note: Unchanged. Zoomed on a 10 m grid, the pin is on bare ground under open pines at the meadow's edge beside the drawn Forest Service loop, which itself runs through the trees off any visible track; no roof or clearing that could be the guard station shows within 150 m, so there is nothing to move it onto.

234206.note: The pin is in the station's yard among its buildings, inside the drawn loop drive off the highway; the white-roofed house 15 m northwest is likely the cabin.

234213.note: The pin is under the trees 30 m east of the drawn road junction, beside small buildings that show among the pines; no lane from the road to them is drawn. The listing's own point, 690 m west, is in open grassland.

234216.note: The Forest Service's point 48 m east-northeast sits under canopy at the loop's junction with the through road, and neither it nor the pin inside the loop shows pads or a clearing in the photo. Not moved.

234239.note: The pin sits on the drawn highway beside the meadow, with no building at it. A small building 40 m east across the road at the meadow's edge may be the cabin, and the camp's buildings are 50 m west; the pin isn't on either.

234252.note: The pin is on the guard station's small building at the forest edge, but the drawn Census loop ends 30 m west of it in the trees, and the visible lane in from the north isn't drawn.

234262.note: The pin is on the cabin below the summit, at the end of the drawn road up the ridge; the lookout itself shows 70 m north along a footpath.

234274.note: The pin is inside the paved loop at the top of the lake's campground, beside its building, and the drawn loop follows the pavement. The listing's own point, 590 m south, is at the lake's day-use area.

234276.note: The pin is on the rental's green-roofed building in the meadow, beside the drawn road along the valley.

234279.note: The pin is under the trees 15 m west of the station's yard, between its buildings, and the drawn loop drive passes 20 m east; which building is the caretaker's cabin isn't plain.

234284.note: The Forest Service's point, 125 m east of the pin and 30 m from the drawn road to the southeast, is under closed fir, and the dense ground relief shows only smooth forest floor there, no building gap or levelled pad; the pin by the drawn spur shows two small pits but no building either. Not moved.

234315.note: The guard station's buildings stand in the meadow beside the drawn road 720 m east of the pin, which was in unbroken forest; the pin now sits on the gray-roofed building nearest the listing's own point.

234317.note: The pin is beside a small structure in the open meadow below the dam, and a faint visible track runs from it 40 m to the drawn road, which isn't drawn. The listing's own point, 530 m southeast, is at a road junction in the meadow with nothing on it.

234320.note: The Forest Service's point 41 m northwest shows only a grassy opening under trees, while the pin sits at the corner of a gray rectangle about 10 by 4 m with a faint lane to it, which may be the cabin's roof but could be a gravel pad. Not moved; the roof reading needs a second look.

234363.note: The lidar relief shows a building's footprint right at the pin (a flat blank where no ground points fall) and the photo a roof there in a small clearing, which reads as the guard station; the intensity shows its drives off the road as dark bands, which the short drawn spur follows only roughly (within about 5 m) to a point 23 m south of the building. Nothing traced.

234384.note: The pin is beside the lookout on the bare rock summit, 25 m from the end of the drawn road, which follows the visible switchback up.

234407.note: The pin is in the group campground's pine grove inside the drawn loop, with the visible gravel lanes round it. The listing's own point, 9.8 km away, is in unbroken forest.

234445.note: The lidar relief shows the pin on a levelled bench between two drainages, and the photo a small blue roof 10 m northwest and a light dirt patch off Crooked River Road, which the drawn road follows on its band in the intensity; that reads as the cabin's yard, 25 m west of the road, though no drive to it shows plainly enough to trace. Nothing traced.

234498.note: The Forest Service's point, 130 m northwest, is on the highway at the spur's turnoff, which is the entrance, not the group site; the pin stays on the smooth flat by the lakeshore at the spur's end, which the relief shows as level ground but not as a plainly shaped pad, and the photo is canopy. Not moved.

234503.note: The Forest Service's point 73 m south lies near the end of the drawn southern road on smooth floodplain, and the pin on the same floodplain to the north; neither the photo's sunlit gaps nor the ground relief shows a plain group pad at either. Not moved.

234554.note: The pin is in chaparral 30 m east of the drawn road beside a small paved patch; 140 m south a drawn loop has a shelter and a round paved area and another loop has single-site spurs, so which is the group campground isn't plain.

234567.note: The pin is on the cabin's roof beside the gravel road in the open draw, and the drawn road follows the visible road past it.

234572.note: The Forest Service's point 83 m west-southwest is on a drawn track in open sagebrush with no building, and at the pin the only structure is a small pale roof 25 m north-northeast, too small to say it is the station. Not moved.

234581.note: The pin is beside the guard station's blue-roofed cabin among its outbuildings, and the drawn spur off the valley road ends at it.

234626.note: The Forest Service's point (one "Twilight Group Site" shared with Upper Twilight), 215 m northwest of the pin, is under pines beside the drawn road with no clearing, pad or parking; the pin stays at the south edge of the bare rocky clearing by the road, where nothing tells this site from Upper Twilight's. Not moved.

234627.note: The Forest Service's point (one "Twilight Group Site" for both the upper and lower listings), 210 m northwest of the pin, is under pines just south of the drawn road with no clearing, pad or parking; the pin stays in the bare rocky clearing by the road that it shares with Lower Twilight, where nothing marks either site. Not moved.

234632.note: The Forest Service's point ("Swan Lake" group campground), 140 m south of the pin by the lakeshore, is under trees with no pad or shelter; 15 m north of it the gravel pad by the drawn road holds a long white object like a trailer, not plainly the kitchen shelter. The pin is in unbroken forest. Not moved.

234663.note: The pin is at the west edge of the group campground's open gravel loop by the highway, and the drawn loop goes round it. The listing's own point, 1.3 km south, is on an empty sagebrush slope.

234760.note: The lidar relief (Oregon DOGAMI) puts the pin on a river terrace with the drawn spur running along a smoother strip south of it, but the terrace is mottled by the forest floor and shows no levelled clearing or pads; the photo shows only a small bare patch beside the pin under the trees. The group site can't be confirmed; not traced.

252282.note: Moved the pin 33 m northwest onto the gray-roofed cabin, where the Forest Service's point for the Crescent Lake guard station falls; the old pin was under the pines with nothing at it. No drawn road reaches it (an undrawn drive runs north; the drawn road passes 35 m east).

261791.note: The pin is on the group campground's building in its mown clearing below the highway, and the drawn drive from the highway loops into it.

267559.note: The drawn loop 70 m west of the pin encloses the group site's cleared ground and its shelter; the pin, which was on an open juniper slope across the wash, now sits at the shelter.

273818.note: The pin is on the group shelter's red roof at the meadow's edge, and the drawn loop off the road ends at its gravel pad.

234067.note: The pin is on the drawn loop among the group site's parked trailers by the lakeshore. The listing's own point, 12.8 km west, is in unbroken forest.
